title: The facts SP-gcerxjsg reworded in gitlab/project-settings-api and gitlab/pipelines-rules get anchor rows
goal: Anchor the two DOC facts BG-drzst6zj and BG-lmp4mxmo reworded without anchors, since _anchors.csv was outside their touches: gitlab/project-settings-api.md:17 (S-4yvdwu5c, the create and update table attributes) and gitlab/pipelines-rules.md:32 (S448, the Run button's once-per-minute limit; quote: You can manually run scheduled pipelines once per minute.), each with factdiff.py anchor --file F --quotes CSV, keeping only those facts' rows (found by the SP-gcerxjsg retrospective).

run: import csv,sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kbfacts; ks=[kbfacts.fact_key(u["text"]) for u in kbfacts.units("public") if (u["path"].endswith("/project-settings-api.md") and "appear in neither" in u["text"]) or (u["path"].endswith("/pipelines-rules.md") and "once per minute" in u["text"] and "S448" in u["text"])]; rows={r["fact"] for r in csv.DictReader(open("kb/public/_anchors.csv",encoding="utf-8")) if r["status"]=="located"}; sys.exit(0 if len(ks)==2 and all(k in rows for k in ks) else 1)
